Review of allocate_backorders (request_changes): The implementation currently enforces a 'Ship Complete' policy (all SKUs in an order must be fully satisfiable for any allocation to occur), but this is not mentioned in the docstring. Typically, backorders are partially filled. Please update the logic to allocate as much as possible for each SKU in the order, regardless of whether the entire order can be completed, to align with the described sequential allocation process.
